thread:
leah: Hey team - wrt last night's production paging, I'm starting this thread to coordinate the post-incident follow-ups and the customer briefing logistics. TL;DR: mitigation worked, no data exfiltration, ~12% of hosted inference traffic saw 5-10s additional latency for ~45m. Need postmortem, action items, and a customer-facing recap by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Thanks. Quick note: root cause looks like a cascading autoscaler mis-eval + one bad model rollout variant hitting a path that disabled KV cache for a subset of requests. I have logs and a diag runbook in the incident artifacts.

alex: Confirmed. I captured the KV cache miss rate spike at 02:14-02:58 UTC. Attaching query snippets below.

alex: ```
# kibana query snippet
index=prod-inference logs | where kv_cache_hit == false | stats count() by model_variant, minute
```

leah: Good. For coordination: we need (1) a postmortem meeting (RCA), (2) concrete action owners + timelines, (3) status page recap, and (4) customer email/RCA share + trust plan. Who can own each?

maria: I can own the RCA draft (technical). Will pull kernel selection logs and profiling. ETA: EOD tomorrow for first draft.

alex: I'll own the infra action items (autoscaler tuning + alerting). Propose owners/timelines below.

carla: I'll draft the customer-facing summary with the support tone and offer; will need the timeline and the RCA points to finalize. Prefer to get the summary by tomorrow morning to align with customer business hours.

aaron: I'll own scheduling and the customer comms approval loop. I'll loop legal/CS if needed.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1951234567: status changed to RESOLVED by leah at 1951238760 (bot note). Duration: 45m. Impact: elevated latency for subset of requests.

leah: Action item table proposal (please react with :thumbsup: or comment to change):
- A1: autoscaler policy review + quick revert guard -> owner: alex -> due: 2025-06-05 18:00 UTC -> ticket: INF-4721
- A2: model rollout verification step to catch KV-cache disabling behavior -> owner: maria -> due: 2025-06-06 18:00 UTC -> ticket: MLR-301
- A3: status page update & customer email draft -> owner: carla -> due: 2025-06-04 12:00 UTC -> ticket: COMMS-89
- A4: SLA/credit assessment + legal check -> owner: aaron -> due: 2025-06-05 12:00 UTC -> ticket: BIZ-15

maria: I added A2 to MLR-301 and started a small repro job. If we confirm it's model-variant specific I'll add a blocklist step for rollouts.

alex: For A1, immediate mitigations we did: forced a scale-up to saturate cache nodes and rolled back the variant. Long-term: refine the autoscaler threshold to include KV cache hit-rate. I'll put the proposal in INF-4721.

carla: Draft for status page (copy below). Please check and suggest edits. Need sign-off before posting.

carla: ```
Incident: Elevated inference latency for a subset of customers
Start: 2025-06-03 02:13 UTC
End: 2025-06-03 02:58 UTC
Impact: Increased response latency (5-10s) for ~12% of hosted requests. No customer data was exposed.
Next steps: RCA in progress; we'll share a detailed summary and remediation plan by 2025-06-05.
```

leah: That looks good. Add a line: "Customers with ongoing payments not impacted for model inference pricing"? maybe too producty. Keep it neutral. Also include contact support link.

carla: Updated - will include support link and link to SLA page.

aaron: Proposed customer email draft (short):

aaron: Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to follow up about the latency event on 2025-06-03. Root cause analysis is underway; initial findings show an autoscaler + model rollout interaction that increased latency for some requests. We have mitigated the issue and set out a remediation plan. We will share a full RCA and planned fixes by 2025-06-05. If you'd like a sync, we can arrange a call. - Aaron, Redwood Inference

leah: Good start. Carla, can you make that warmer and include the offer for a 1:1 technical walkthrough? Also mention timeframe for RCA.

carla: Yup. I'll post a polished version here by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. One question: do we commit to the 2025-06-05 RCA publish date?

maria: Depends on repro and perf run. I think EOD 6/5 for draft is reasonable, final RCA by 6/6 after reviews.

leah: OK. We'll commit to a "detailed RCA by EOD 2025-06-05" in the customer email and note that a final updated RCA will be posted after internal review on 2025-06-06.

alex: Scheduling the RCA meeting: I propose 2025-06-05 16:00 UTC for the internal postmortem (30-45m). Who's available?

maria: I can make that.

carla: I can make the first 30 minutes.

aaron: I can make it too. I'll create a calendar invite and attach incident artifacts.

leah: Please include the following artifacts in the meeting packet: diag runbook, KV cache logs, autoscaler graphs, model rollout snapshot, and a draft customer message. Put links in the meeting invite.

aaron: Will do. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.example/meet/pm/1951234567 (private link)

alex: Small ops note: add an alert for sudden KV cache hit ratio drops > 30% in 5m windows. That's A1 follow-up.

maria: Also adding a unit test to the rollout harness to assert KV cache usage isn't disabled by variant flags. Included in MLR-301.

leah: One more: customer-specific outreach. We identified 3 customers in the impacted cohort (IDs: cust-198, cust-214, cust-305). Carla, can you prioritize outreach to them for a targeted briefing?

carla: Yes - I'll DM the CS reps and draft tailored notes for each.

incident-bot: NOTE: artifacts uploaded to /incidents/1951234567/artifacts (logs, dashboards, repro-run.zip).

leah: Great. Recap + owners:
- RCA draft: maria -> EOD 6/5 -> confluence: (will post link)
- Infra tuning + alert: alex -> 6/5 18:00 UTC -> INF-4721
- Customer comms + status page: carla -> 6/4 12:00 UTC -> COMMS-89
- SLA check: aaron -> 6/5 12:00 UTC -> BIZ-15

leah: If nobody objects, I'll post the status page after carla's sign-off and send an initial customer note tomorrow morning. Please add any other blockers.

maria: No blockers from me.

alex: No blockers. I'll start on the alert and put the PR up for review tomorrow morning.

carla: Will post draft here by 09:00 UTC. If leah signs off I'll post the status page at ~12:00 UTC.

aaron: I'll add legal and CS to the approval loop. Also recommend we offer a 7-day credit if customers report measurable impact - want input from biz/legal.

leah: Noted. Thanks everyone. I'll run the postmortem invite and check in after the RCA draft is up. :white_check_mark:

carla: Thanks - leaning on the group for quick reviews so we can keep to the timeline. :wave:
